questions.prompt: Which of the following statements best describes Moore's prediction or Moore's law:
options: Every action has an equal and opposite reaction.
The number of components in an IC can never be increased.
The number of components in an IC realized at minimum cost will double every year or every two years.
The sizes of transistors in ICs realized at minimum cost will remain constant.
questions.accepted: The number of components in an IC realized at minimum cost will double every year or every two years.

questions.prompt: What is the purpose of masks in photolithography:
options: Define shapes/patterns that need to be obtained on the wafer.
Isolate multiple layers of interconnect.
Etch silicon during chemical etching.
Oxidize silicon after photolithography.
questions.accepted: Define shapes/patterns that need to be obtained on the wafer.

questions.prompt: Which of the following statements is incorrect:
options: Multiple dies are fabricated on a single silicon wafer.
Silicon wafers are sliced out from silicon ingots.
We get silicon ingots from a silicon die.
We obtain a chip after packaging a die.
questions.accepted: We get silicon ingots from a silicon die.

questions.prompt: Which of the following statements is incorrect:
options: The semiconductor manufacturing plant where integrated circuits are fabricated is called a semiconductor foundry.
Fabless design companies design integrated circuits.
Setting up a semiconductor foundry requires a huge investment.
Designing integrated circuits is done in semiconductor foundries.
questions.accepted: Designing integrated circuits is done in semiconductor foundries.

questions.prompt: Which among the following design styles require maximum design effort:
options: Standard cell-based design
Full-custom design
Gate array-based design
FPGA-based design

questions.prompt: Which among the following is a variable cost in standard cell-based design:
options: Design cost
Cost of mask
Cost of design tools
Cost of die

questions.prompt: Which of the following representation of a design has the highest degree of abstraction:
options: As RTL in Verilog
As an algorithm in the programming language C
As connection of logic gates in Verilog
As the layout of transistors and interconnects.
questions.accepted: As an algorithm in the programming language C

questions.prompt: For which of the following figures of merit, dedicated hardware can be better than the same function implemented as software running on a general-purpose processor:
options: Risk due to bug
Development time
Speed
Flexibility in implementation and customization

questions.prompt: What is the purpose of carrying out hardware-software partitioning for a system?
options: It gets rid of all the software in the system.
It chooses an optimal combination of hardware and software to implement the system.
It gets rid of all the hardware in the system.
It compiles the software of the system.
questions.accepted: It chooses an optimal combination of hardware and software to implement the system.

questions.prompt: Which of the following statements best describes the purpose of behavior synthesis in VLSI design flow?
options: It converts an algorithm to an equivalent design in RTL.
It converts an algorithm to a binary executable.
It converts an algorithm into sequences of zeros and ones.
It converts an algorithm to an assembly language code.
questions.accepted: It converts an algorithm to an equivalent design in RTL.
